title: Both planets turn direct
lines: Mercury at 5° Scorpio, Venus at 22° Libra: the pause lifts.
caption:
Mercury stationed direct at 5° Scorpio on Nov 13–14, and Venus turns direct at 22° Libra on Nov 14. ✨

Tradition reads a station as the moment a planet stands still before it changes course. Mercury has been retracing Scorpio ground since Oct 24; now conversations, plans and paperwork start moving forward again. The shadow runs until Nov 30, so the 'review' words still apply for two more weeks.

Venus direct in Libra turns attention back to how we give and receive in close relationships.

title: Sagittarius season begins
lines: The Sun moves into the sign of the seeker and the long view.
caption:
The Sun enters Sagittarius on Nov 23. ♐

After Scorpio's depth, Sagittarius season turns toward the horizon: travel, study, belief and the bigger picture. Ruled by Jupiter, it is the sign tradition links with questions of meaning.

In the Vedic (sidereal) zodiac the Sun enters Sagittarius in mid-December, which is why your Vedic Sun sign may differ from your Western one.

title: Full Moon, 2° Gemini
lines: Tonight 14:54 UTC the Moon opposes the Sun: what you started comes to light.
caption:
Full Moon at 2° Gemini on Nov 24, 14:54 UTC. 🌕

The Moon sits opposite the Sun, with the Sun in Sagittarius and the Moon in Gemini, the sign pair of facts and meaning, details and the big picture. Tradition reads a Full Moon as a time when what was begun at the last New Moon comes to light.

The New Moon was Nov 9 in Scorpio. What has become clear since?
